summary:
Main
On the fourth session of the holiday China remained dark across the board, but this issue brought somethingmore important than price - a hard supply number. For the week to Oct 2, Brazilian iron ore shipments reached 8.5967 million mt, up 1.8195 million mt or 26.85% WoW, reversing two straight weeks of decline, while Australia fell 1.2988 million mt (-6.26%) to 19.4645 million and the global total came in at 35.9424 million mt (+1.21%). Essentially all of the growth came from Brazil.
